title: Fixed cell selection around merged cells: a selection now always covers every merged cell it touches, a merged cell whose rows a filter or `trimRows` hides no longer extends the selection over other cells, and an arrow key pressed after Tab or Enter inside a range moves on from the focused cell, not from a merged cell the focus skipped. A selection layer that Tab or Enter leaves keeps its last focused cell, as it does without merged cells. `beforeSelectionFocusSet` and `afterSelectionFocusSet` now receive the cell the focus lands on, and global `beforeSelectionHighlightSet`, `modifyTransformStart`, and `modifyTransformEnd` listeners now receive the range or step already adjusted for merged cells, as listeners added through the settings already did. Deprecated `getStartMostColumnIndex()`, `getEndMostColumnIndex()`, `getTopMostRowIndex()`, and `getBottomMostRowIndex()` of `MergedCellsCollection`.
